cards.claim: Perfect Scoundrels works in the adventure genre.
cards.quote: In this moment, I realized that Felix Flynn's exploits were not just the stuff of legend, but the foundation of a much larger, more complex world of adventure and intrigue. A world where scoundrels and heroes blurred the lines, and the pursuit of treasure was just the beginning of a much greater quest.

cards.claim: Perfect Scoundrels belongs to the realm of drama television series.
cards.quote: However, when it comes to "Perfect Scoundrels," there is no doubt that it firmly belongs to the realm of drama television series.
